guidelines.knives: Blades with cutting length under 9 inches (22.86 cm) and width under 2 inches are permissible for culinary, sporting, hunting, and utility purposes without an arms license under Section 4 of the Arms Act (subject to state-specific notifications).
guidelines.bows: Archery recurve bows, compound bows, and target arrows are classified as sporting goods and do not require an arms license.
guidelines.selfDefense: Civilian-grade pepper spray canisters (capsaicin formula) and stun devices with safety disable pins are legal for personal safety and defense of person/property under Section 96 to 106 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC).
guidelines.ageRestriction: Minimum age of 18 years verified via Government Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, or Driving License).
